title: Transitions & Color Grades Demo
description: Demonstrates all transition types (fade, slide, zoomblur, cut) combined with color grades (neutral, warm, cool, cinematic, vivid, sepia). Use per-scene [Transition:] and [Grade:] inline tags.
script:
Fade transition with warm golden tones. [Visual: golden hour sunset field] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
Slide transition with cool blue tones. [Visual: blue ocean waves coast] [Transition: slide] [Grade: cool]
Zoomblur transition with cinematic look. [Visual: cinematic film movie set] [Transition: zoomblur] [Grade: cinematic]
Hard cut with vivid colors. [Visual: vibrant colorful festival] [Transition: cut] [Grade: vivid]
Soft fade with sepia vintage feel. [Visual: vintage old photograph] [Transition: fade] [Grade: sepia]
